environment.description: ECS Fargate task deployed within an EKS-managed Fargate profile (EKS on Fargate). The pod runs in namespace 'prod-auth' which has a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy of type Egress applied with podSelector matching label app=auth-service. The egress policy specifies an explicit allowlist of CIDR blocks for permitted destinations and notably does NOT include 169.254.169.254/32 or 169.254.170.2/32 in the allowed egress CIDRs. The policy uses 'except' notation: allows 0.0.0.0/0 except [169.254.0.0/16]. Additionally, the Fargate profile has a custom ENI configuration with a secondary security group (sg-0a8f3c2d) that has no outbound rule for 169.254.0.0/16. The VPC CNI plugin enforces the NetworkPolicy via eBPF dataplane (vpc-cni v1.15+ with ENABLE_NETWORK_POLICY=true).
